item.title: How to detect OMI in 10 Steps?
item.description:
The basics

The OMI concept was put forward in 2018 by Stephen W. Smith, Pendell Meyers, and Scott Weingart. The main reasoning was that the current STEMI criteria are not a good tool for identifying which patients will benefit from PCI. So they introduced OMI as a better way to find ACO (Acute coronary occlusion).

The new OMI/NOMI paradigm is not limited to the ECG, but the ECG is still the cornerstone of the concept, mainly because it's fast, repeatable, non-invasive, and already in wide use.
